#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Apply migration 001 (create the 'orders' table) to the local SQLite database."""

import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path

DB_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "app.db"
MIGRATION_PATH = Path(__file__).resolve().parent / "migrations" / "001_create_orders.sql"


def main() -> None:
    sql = MIGRATION_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8")

    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        conn.executescript(sql)
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()

    print(f"OK: applied {MIGRATION_PATH.name} to {DB_PATH}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
